thread:
isabel: Customer hitting 403 on POC generate endpoint. Says calls worked yesterday. Can someone join?

omar: Can we see the request they sent? 403 payload?

isabel: They sent this curl (key redacted):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-poc-abc' \ 
  -H 'X-Redwood-Tenant: tenant-42' \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-rl2","input":"test"}'
```

zhen: When we looked, token is bound to tenant-7. Response body: `{"error":"forbidden","message":"tenant mismatch: token_tenant=tenant-7, header_tenant=tenant-42"}`

isabel: They were trying to run cross-tenant tests and assumed header would elevate.

omar: Quick customer guidance: either remove X-Redwood-Tenant header or use a token for tenant-42. Also run `/v1/whoami` with the token to confirm.

isabel: Sent whoami snippet to them to run: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-poc-abc" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/whoami`

zhen: Also note scopes: if token lacks `generate` scope, POST to /generate will 403 even if tenant matches. Ask for whoami output so we can see scopes.

isabel: They replied with whoami: `{"tenant":"tenant-7","project":"demo-1","scopes":["embeddings"]}`

omar: There's the problem: only embeddings scope. Recommend `generate` or combined scope for POC.

isabel: They say after swapping in correct token they still saw bursts of 429s. support-bot flagged a quota spike.

support-bot: alert: 429 rate_limit_exceeded for tenant-42 (burst). retry-after: 12s

zhen: Their test runner retried on 403 and then hammered us once they fixed it. Explain exponential backoff and pause test runners.

omar: For the demo we can issue a scoped POC token: e.g., `poc_cross_tenant` valid 5 days, 200k tokens, rate limit 300RPM. Sales-ops needs to approve for billing/cost coverage.

sales-ops: Approved for one-time demo token; AE please log in deal memo.

isabel: They also requested a short blurb for their security review showing token binding behavior and audit log retention. I'll attach a one-pager: token binding, whoami example, log sample lines, retention TTL (90d default for POC), KMS options.

zhen: I'll add a checklist to the ticket: whoami, raw response body, remove header if unnecessary, confirm scopes, pause runner.

isabel: Customer swapped to the POC token we issued, ran tests slower, 403s cleared and 429s subsided. They asked to keep the POC token until end of week. Closing the swarm unless anything else comes up. :thumbsup:
